description:
A TypeSafeClient that evaluates in-process on ONNX Runtime instead of calling the
    TypeSafe API: Laya (a ModernBERT decision model), Clef-flash (Qwen3.5-9B + joint schema head) or
    Qwen2.5 (next-token logits), read from a
    local model directory. API parity, not model parity with Jev. Depends on typesafe-java-core and
    ONNX Runtime, plus a Codec module (codec-jackson2 or codec-jackson3) at run time, like the API client.
